events.label: 16 Nov 2026
events.text: Grid operators' responses to the federal large-load orders were due
events.outcome: Five of the six operators filed by the deadline; Southwest Power Pool's deadline is 20 Nov. No ruling yet.

events.label: 17 Nov 2026
events.text: Loudoun County vote on a 12-month pause on new applications
events.outcome: Passed 7 to 1 with one abstention. Backdated to 15 Sep 2026; runs to as late as September 2027. 33 applications were active.

events.label: 27 Nov 2026
events.text: Thailand draft requiring 80% reuse of cooling-tower discharge goes to the national data centre board

events.label: By 29 Nov 2026
events.text: Spain: Cabinet approval of the data centre decree targeted before the general election

events.label: 9 Dec 2026
events.text: PJM 2029/30 capacity auction opens

events.label: 10 Dec 2026
events.text: Texas statewide audit report on the large-load pause

events.label: 14 Dec 2026
events.text: European Union consultation on minimum performance standards for data centres closes

events.label: 16 Dec 2026
events.text: Replies due to the grid operators' large-load filings at the federal regulator

events.label: 17 Dec 2026
events.text: Texas utility regulator expected to meet on the audit reports

events.label: 22 Dec 2026
events.text: PJM 2029/30 auction results published

events.label: Dec 2026 to Jan 2027
events.text: 2026 Long-Term Reliability Assessment published

events.label: 12 Jan 2027
events.text: Texas Legislature convenes, with data centre bills already filed

events.label: 19 Jan 2027
events.text: New Texas governor takes office; new Congress sits in January

events.label: 28 Feb 2027
events.text: Federal suspension of the PJM backstop auction ends

events.label: 1 Mar 2027
events.text: Proposed bid opening for the PJM backstop auction

events.label: 10 Mar 2027
events.text: Korea's AI Data Centre Act enters into force

events.label: 12 Mar 2027
events.text: Last day to file bills in the Texas Legislature

events.label: 9 Apr 2027
events.text: Deadline for Texas's study of large-load connections; the grid operator has said it will miss it

events.label: 28 Apr 2027
events.text: PJM backstop target of about 6.8 gigawatts is reset

events.label: 31 May 2027
events.text: Texas legislative session ends; a special session is possible afterwards

events.label: Second quarter 2027
events.text: European Union proposal on minimum performance standards

events.label: Mid-2027, earliest
events.text: Johor's reported freeze on water-cooled builds ends

events.label: Jul 2027
events.text: Oregon's data centre permit pause ends

events.label: Aug 2027
events.text: European Union public water-efficiency labels start for sites of 500 kilowatts or more

events.label: 2027 dry season
events.text: Test of commercial water supply in India's main hubs

events.label: Sep 2027, latest
events.text: Loudoun County's pause on new data centre applications ends
Korea regional connections checkpoint; first Texas 765 kilovolt lines late in the year
events.note: The Texas lines are a driver for the North America power call

events.label: Aug 2029, earliest
events.text: Kashiwazaki-Kariwa Unit 7 restart
